No limb of POL-NS-01 to POL-NS-09 reads a route field on a no-show, because the trip was cancelled before it ran; the absence is a property of the source platform's export rather than of the record; and no issue code is minted for it, because the corpus's PARTIAL_RECORD was applied to a ledger missing its itemisation, not to a field the source platform does not export. Filling them with a plausible route would be inventing the quote.

fields.value: I was at the pickup point at Tiong Bahru Plaza on time but the driver never showed up. I waited 10 minutes at the lobby and couldn't find the car. The app charged me a $5.00 cancellation fee for a 'no-show' which is completely unfair — I was there, the driver was not. I want the charge reversed immediately.
fields.reason: the source states this value and the converted case carries it
The source has no 'amount contested' field. The cancellation fee is what the rider's claim asks to have reversed, and it is the figure the fare breakdown charges, so it is the figure contested.

policy_divergences.finding: The source's cancellation fee of SGD 5.00 matches no entry in fee_schedule.
policy_divergences.this_system: fee_schedule.zone_class_fee_sgd for STANDARD is 4.00 and vehicle_tier_fee_sgd for RYDE_X is 4.00; the greater is 4.00. No combination of zone class and vehicle tier in the schedule produces 5.00.
policy_divergences.effect: The converted case carries the source's 5.00 unchanged, because changing it would be editing the evidence. POL-NS-08(d) is therefore engaged on the converted case.
policy_divergences.resolution: fee_schedule.resolution_rule reads trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (5.00) first; POL-NS-08(d) is no longer engaged on the converted case.

policy_divergences.finding: The source's 8-minute no-show threshold has no counterpart in POL-NS.
policy_divergences.this_system: POL-NS-01(c) sets the dwell minimum from fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec: 300 s (5 min) for STANDARD, LARGE_VENUE and TRANSPORT_HUB, 480 s (8 min) for AIRPORT. The source's flat 8 minutes is not this system's rule, and this system's figure varies by zone class where the source's does not.
policy_divergences.effect: The converted case carries no threshold of its own: the threshold is read from the loaded policy at arbitration time, as it is for every case.
policy_divergences.resolution: POL-NS-01(c) reads platform_policy.free_wait_sec (300) and no_show_threshold_sec (480); the cancellation at 08:51:00 falls at the 8-minute threshold measured from the 08:43 arrival.

policy_divergences.finding: Whether the waiting clock runs from arrival or from the scheduled time is a question this system's policy does not address.
policy_divergences.source_policy: scheduled_time 08:45, driver_arrival_time 08:43; the source's own app events start the free-wait timer at arrival (wait_timer_started at 08:43:10), and the cancellation at 08:51:00 falls exactly on an 8-minute threshold measured from arrival.
policy_divergences.this_system: POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell 'from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the arrived event'. That answers a different question from the one the source's timers answer: it fixes the start of the dwell, and is silent on whether a scheduled time could start anything.
policy_divergences.effect: Recorded and NOT resolved. On this case the point does not bite, because no fix carries an accuracy value and POL-NS-02 therefore yields no qualifying in-geofence fix at all, so the dwell cannot be measured either way.
policy_divergences.resolution: scheduled_at is now carried as trip_record.scheduled_at, and POL-NS-10(b) reads it. POL-NS-01(c) still runs the clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and the platform's own wait_timer_started event (08:43:10) is a second, independent carrier of the same start.

policy_divergences.finding: The source's fee goes to driver_compensation without the platform share this system applies.
policy_divergences.this_system: POL-NS-07 compensates the driver at 80 percent of the fee, the residual 20 percent being retained as the platform service fee.
policy_divergences.effect: The converted case carries no compensation figure; POL-NS-07 computes it from the fee at arbitration time.
